description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

summary.one_liner: magpie is a local gateway and menu bar app that lets you point agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI at any model or provider, with failover across accounts.
keywords: use my chatgpt plan in other tools
use_cases: Run Claude Code or Codex on a non-default model such as DeepSeek or Kimi
Fail over to another account when a subscription quota runs out
Share one set of provider keys across several agents and machines
Mask API keys and personal data in prompts before they reach a vendor
Add web search or image generation to models that lack them
Track token usage and cost across agents and providers
stack: Bun (for plugins, downloaded on first use)
OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini API formats
notable: Local gateway at 127.0.0.1:3425 translating between OpenAI Chat, OpenAI Responses, Anthropic Messages and Gemini formats, including streaming and tool calls
Routing groups with smart, order, rotate, usage and pace modes that fail over across keys and subscriptions
Privacy masking that swaps secrets for placeholders before requests leave the machine and restores them in replies
Edits each agent's own config file atomically, preserving comments and formatting
Plugin system with OpenCode auth plugins, pi packages and JavaScript gateway middleware
caveats: Privacy masking is off by default and must be enabled in Settings; the optional local name/address model is a 1.6 GB download
Pull requests are not accepted; only maintainers open them, and feedback goes through Discord
Plugins require Bun, downloaded the first time one is needed
Some features, such as the menu bar app, are tied to specific platforms; the README lists macOS, Windows, Linux, Docker and Termux
